candidate_dispositions.source: Harte, Gravitational lensing beyond geometric optics I, arXiv:1808.06203v2
candidate_dispositions.evidence: The legacy research source map includes Harte, but its retained supplier-reading record assigns the inspected wave-optics and transport results to ML05. Those results do not support a curvature table or the selected smooth charged-dust family. Carroll and Tong independently cover the geometry conventions, Meinel–Hütten supplies model context, and the full local arguments cover every MM02 claim.
